gitCommit.subject: test: leaner test strategy — tablet-default viewport, selective e2e, prune ceremony (#312)
gitCommit.body:
test: leaner test strategy — tablet-default viewport, selective e2e, prune ceremony (#312)

* test: drop cross-tier duplicate + vanity DB tests; collapse e2e viewport matrix (phone WebKit-redundant)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UQS4F4JxwFSyyMxHhVdSYz

* test: drop copy-inventory / register-scan / tautology tests (leaner testing principle)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UQS4F4JxwFSyyMxHhVdSYz

* test(e2e): tablet is the sole default viewport; phone/desktop opt-in via PW_VIEWPORT

Ordinary CI/local e2e runs one viewport (tablet, 61 tests, was 181 across 3).
PW_VIEWPORT=phone|desktop runs ONLY that viewport for viewport-specific work.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UQS4F4JxwFSyyMxHhVdSYz

* ci(e2e): run only the specs for a PR's touched flows; full suite on merge-to-main

The e2e job ran the whole Playwright suite whenever any UI path changed. Add
per-flow area filters (dorny/paths-filter) mapping SOURCE paths -> e2e areas,
plus a `broad` blast-radius flag. A new "Select e2e specs" step unions the
touched areas' specs with an always-on layout/smoke/a11y floor and runs only
those; it falls back to the FULL suite on merge-to-main, on a broad change, or
when a UI change maps to no area (never under-test). The e2e job stays a
skippable-on-ui==false required check; selective runs can never be empty.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UQS4F4JxwFSyyMxHhVdSYz

* docs(architecture): decision 11 — leaner test strategy (tablet-default viewport, selective e2e, tier principle)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UQS4F4JxwFSyyMxHhVdSYz
